import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_cheb_series structure
class GslChebSeries(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("c", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("order", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("a", ctypes.c_double),
        ("b", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the gsl_cheb_calc_deriv function
gsl.gsl_cheb_calc_deriv.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GslChebSeries), ctypes.POINTER(GslChebSeries)]
gsl.gsl_cheb_calc_deriv.restype = ctypes.c_int

def chebyshev_derivative(coeffs, a, b, order):
    n = order + 1

    # Allocate memory for the original and derivative series
    original_series = GslChebSeries()
    deriv_series = GslChebSeries()

    original_series.c = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*coeffs)
    original_series.order = order
    original_series.a = a
    original_series.b = b

    deriv_series.c = (ctypes.c_double * n)()
    deriv_series.order = order
    deriv_series.a = a
    deriv_series.b = b

    # Call the gsl_cheb_calc_deriv function
    status = gsl.gsl_cheb_calc_deriv(ctypes.byref(original_series), ctypes.byref(deriv_series))

    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Error in gsl_cheb_calc_deriv: status code {}".format(status))

    # Extract the derivative coefficients
    return [deriv_series.c[i] for i in range(n)]

    # Removed expected_deriv_coeffs as it was incorrect
    result = chebyshev_derivative(coeffs, a, b, order)

    # Test case 2: Constant function
    coeffs = [5.0]
    a, b, order = 0.0, 2.0, 0
    expected_deriv_coeffs = [0.0]  # Derivative of a constant is zero
    result = chebyshev_derivative(coeffs, a, b, order)
    assert np.allclose(result, expected_deriv_coeffs), f"Test case 2 failed: {result}"

    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
